raw_response:
I've been working this land for 37 years, so I know what each plot can give me. With 12 mu total and my wheat-maize rotation as the backbone, I split it this way: 8 mu for the wheat-maize double cropping on my better land near the well, 2 mu chili on the plot closer to the village where I can watch for pests, and 2 mu cotton on the sandier corner where wheat doesn't do as well.

For winter wheat, I aim for around 500 kg/mu — that's realistic here, not the 600 the demonstration plots claim. I'll use improved varieties like Jimai 22 — hybrids for wheat aren't worth it here. I apply about 12 kg N/mu as base (diammonium phosphate plus urea, about one bag of DAP per mu), then top-dress 10 kg N/mu at jointing when the rain comes or after irrigation. That's 22 kg N total. Phosphorus 8 kg/mu from the DAP, potassium 6 kg/mu — our soil has some K already but wheat still responds. I irrigate 3 times: pre-sowing, jointing, grain-filling. Two pesticide sprays — one for aphids and powdery mildew at heading, one earlier for weeds. Rotary tillage after maize harvest, I can't afford the time for deep ploughing every year.

For summer maize after wheat, I use Zhengdan 958 or similar hybrid — everyone around here does, yields 550 kg/mu reliably. N about 20 kg/mu split as base and big-flare stage top-dress. P 6 kg/mu, K 6 kg/mu. Irrigate twice if the summer rain is weak — tasseling is critical. Two pesticide sprays for corn borer and armyworm. No-tillage direct seeding into wheat stubble saves me 3 days.

Cotton: I use Bt hybrid, about 15 kg N/mu split across the season — too much nitrogen makes it grow tall with no bolls. P 8 kg/mu, K 10 kg/mu because cotton really needs potassium for boll filling. 4 irrigations, 5 pesticide sprays (mirids and aphids now that bollworm is less). Plough deeply — cotton wants loose soil.

Chili needs the most care and money. Improved variety, transplanted. N 20 kg/mu, P 12 kg/mu, K 18 kg/mu — chili loves potassium and phosphorus for fruit set. 6 irrigations, 6 pesticide sprays for anthracnose and aphids. Plough and bed up. I expect about 2000 kg fresh/mu — this is my cash crop.
